texts.en:
We know many voices within the Shroud; their echoes are omnipresent and multitudinous. After recent trances, our [GetTelepathPlural] have reported the presence of an entity unlike any other - a manifold thrum permeating the very center of the Shroud.

With sufficient application of psionic energy, we can try to follow the psionic trail of this powerful entity, known among our [GetTelepathPlural] as the [Root.Patron:whisperers_in_the_void.GetPreCommunicationName].

notes.zh: 选项后开启“虚空低语者”首次接触特殊项目（常规/蜂巢/机械三种版本），其完成事件 shroud.4045 属于该项目的故事（C3）。编译器未识别 enable_patron_first_contact_project，故此处无连线。
notes.en: Starts the Whisperers in the Void first-contact special project (regular/hive/machine variants); its completion event shroud.4045 belongs to that project story (C3). The compiler does not read enable_patron_first_contact_project, so no edge is drawn here.

texts.zh:
我们正在召集精英灵能使集会，准备向虚境深处进军，与其中力量庞大的势力交流。

在知道这个实体的真名之前，我们会称之为[Root.Patron:whisperers_in_the_void.GetPreCommunicationName]。
texts.en:
We are gathering a convocation of elite telepaths, ready to reach deep into the Shroud and commune with a force of immense power.

Until we know its true name, this being shall be referred to as the [Root.Patron:whisperers_in_the_void.GetPreCommunicationName].

texts.zh:
在尝试与[Root.Patron:whisperers_in_the_void.GetPreCommunicationName]交谈时，我们被拽入了虚境的最深层。虚境的这个内层灵域风平浪静。来自每一个轮回的所有思绪的回想都凝聚成了一种洪荒之力。我们听到了永久的流转带来了寂静之声：虚空之低语。

刺耳的不和谐音包围着我们。而我们正努力倾听无数的信息，终于有一个单一的声音传入我们的[GetTelepathPlural]。

倾听是一种奉献。

如果想抽取这份强大的力量，我们必须帮助这个实体占领[GetCovenantPatronColor]的灵域。如此将会把我们超主的已知存在完全替换掉，打破已签订的契约。

这可能会带来很严重的后果。
texts.en:
In our efforts to commune with the [Root.Patron:whisperers_in_the_void.GetPreCommunicationName] we are drawn into the deepest layers of the Shroud. In this inner domain, the Shroud turns motionlessly. The reflections of every thought, from every cycle, gather into a primary force. We hear the voices of the voiceless, carried in an ageless churn: the Whisperers in the Void.

A rasping discord surrounds us. We strain to hear their numberless messages, until a singular thought grates through our [GetTelepathPlural].

Listening is a sacrifice.

To draw on this great power, we must assist the entity in occupying the domain of [GetCovenantPatronColor]. Such an act would replace our patron's known presence completely, shattering our established Covenant.

This could lead to significant consequences.

这可能会带来很严重的后果。

This could lead to significant consequences.

Ends our Covenant with [GetCovenantPatronColor].
Replaces the domain of [GetCovenantPatronColor] entirely with the Whisperers in the Void.
There will be consequences.

会有一定的后果。

We will choose the domain of a Major Patron to replace with the Whisperers in the Void.
There will be consequences.

label.zh: 最好不要扰乱虚境的平衡。
label.en: Best not disturb the balance of the Shroud.

tooltips.zh: 我们再也不会接受这样的提议了。
tooltips.en: We will never invite an offer like this again.

notes.zh: 审阅注：选项b“拒绝盟约”结束本线（拒绝盟约并重置调谐，获得每月研究与佐罗），不再有后续事件（events/shroud_events.txt shroud.4045）。
notes.en: Review note: option b rejects the covenant and ends the line (refuse_covenant with attunement reset, plus monthly research and Zro); no follow-up events (events/shroud_events.txt, shroud.4045).

texts.zh:
我们的选择刚一做出，[GetTelepathPlural]们就从虚境中暴烈地醒来。他们的脑海中回荡着各种各样的心声。

我们的选择已不可逆转地重塑了对灵能界的认知。随着虚空之低语泄露进的意识，我们现在已经再也感受不到[GetCovenantPatronColor]了；它的灵域对我们而言永久地丧失了。

我们正在逐渐理解低语的意志。我们意识到了祂们关于无尽知识的愿景。只要我们的[GetTelepathPlural]恢复好，我们就可以再次主动行动，与这个无数的存在交流。
texts.en:
As soon as the choice was made, our [GetTelepathPlural] rose from the Shroud in violent wakening. Their minds swam with the echoes of multifarious voices.

Our choice has irrevocably reconfigured our perception of the psionic realm. As the Whisperers in the Void leak into our minds, we can no longer sense [GetCovenantPatronColor] as we once did; its domain is lost to us.

We are slowly comprehending the will of the Whisperers. We sense their vision of limitless knowledge. Once our [GetTelepathPlural] have recovered, we can reach out again and commune with this myriad being.

We are slowly comprehending the will of the Whisperers. We sense their vision of limitless knowledge. Once our [GetTelepathPlural] have recharged, we can reach out again and commune with this myriad being.

texts.zh:
随着[GetTelepathPlural]们浮出虚境，我们发现自己的背叛引来了[GetBetrayedPatronColour]的强力反噬。

[event_target:selected_planet_for_revenge.GetName]附近出现了一道虚境隧道，而它现在也变成了一片无尽废墟的荒芜。我们在隧道的另一头[GetFeltLoc]到了显而易见的愤怒；前超主毫无疑问正在准备复仇。
texts.en:
As our [GetTelepathPlural] emerged from the Shroud, we discovered that our betrayal had caused a powerful backlash from [GetBetrayedPatronColour].

A Shroud Tunnel has emerged near [event_target:selected_planet_for_revenge.GetName], which is now a world of endless wastes. We have [GetFeltLoc] a palpable fury beyond the tunnel; our former patron is no doubt preparing its revenge.

texts.en: We were successful in gathering our forces against the emerging threat. Our ships emitted waves of psionic energy into the Shroud Tunnel, weakening the hostile entity as it breached into our reality.

summary.text:
# 与[Root.Patron:whisperers_in_the_void.GetPreCommunicationName]通灵 / Commune with the [Root.Patron:whisperers_in_the_void.GetPreCommunicationName]

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration (C3)
- 来源 Sources：`common/special_projects/04_projects_shroud.txt` · `events/shroud_events.txt` · `common/patrons/patron_types.txt` · `common/scripted_effects/shroud_shadows_scripted_effects.txt`
- 审阅 Review：2026-10-13（c3b-exploration）· 已审阅 Reviewed

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 伟大赞助者“虚空之低语”：事件shroud.4040由shroud.11001以95%权重触发（events/shroud_events.txt:21888，属另一故事“event-shroud-11000”），该事件在immediate中启用接触项目；patron_types.txt中该赞助者没有first_contact_event，只有covenant_event shroud.4700。  
  Great patron "Whisperers in the Void": shroud.4040 is fired by shroud.11001 with weight 95/100 (events/shroud_events.txt:21888, part of the separate story event-shroud-11000); its immediate enables the contact project. patron_types.txt gives this patron no first_contact_event, only covenant_event shroud.4700.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 4040“尝试沟通”选项（及immediate）按帝国类型启用机械/蜂巢/基础接触项目，完成后触发4045“虚空之低语”。  
  4040 (immediate and option) enables the robot / hive / base contact project by empire type; on completion it fires 4045 "The Whisperers in the Void".
- 4045：若帝国已有四个主要赞助者之一的盟约，选项a→4046“虚境之变”（用虚空之低语替换该赞助者，标记broke_covenant）；否则选项a→11110“循环继续”，由玩家选择吸收哪位赞助者（a-d）。b拒绝（见审阅记录）。  
  4045: with a covenant of one of the four major patrons, option a → 4046 (the Whisperers replace that patron, broke_covenant is set); otherwise option a → 11110 "The Cycle Continues", where the player picks which patron to absorb (a-d). Option b rejects (see review notes).
- 4046与11110都经隐藏事件11111-11114汇入11120“复仇”：选择行星（优先贫瘠行星）并启用对应赞助者的复仇项目；项目成功或失败都触发11130“愤怒的复仇”（出现精神化身）。  
  Both 4046 and 11110 reach 11120 "Vengeance" through hidden events 11111-11114: a planet is chosen (barren ones preferred) and the betrayed patron's revenge project is enabled; success or failure of that project fires 11130 "Furious Vengeance" (a psionic avatar).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 结局：11130复仇化身；或4045.b拒绝盟约。  
  Endings: 11130 (avatar of vengeance) or 4045.b (covenant rejected).

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 4046/11110由是否已有主要赞助者盟约决定；若有 broke_covenant，则11120附加“盟约破裂”修正（10年）。  
  4046 vs 11110 depends on holding a major-patron covenant; with broke_covenant, 11120 adds the covenant_broken_modifier (10 years).

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已对照4040/4045/4046/11110/11111/11120/11130原文与复仇项目脚本。  
  Compared the originals of 4040/4045/4046/11110/11111/11120/11130 and the revenge project scripts.
- 合并：_HIVE与_ROBOT故事并入本故事。  
  Merged: the _HIVE and _ROBOT stories are part of this story.
- 盟约本身（shroud.4700…）是另一故事。  
  The covenant itself (shroud.4700 etc.) is another story.
- 覆盖 Coverage：全部13个文档（含机械/蜂巢版项目）。 / All 13 docs (including robot/hive project versions).
